I’m not going to deal with all of the idiotic replies. But pretending that Trump didn’t threaten to invade a NATO ally is just more hackery.


LibertasFanatic (@GiveAllLiberty)

He poisoned the alliance by calling out their own failings in this first term. The media harangued him for calling them out, making the truth seem bad.



— https://nitter.net/GiveAllLiberty/status/2040231736840196518#m

I agree with some of this directionally, but my God the refusal to acknowledge that Trump has worked assiduously to poison the alliance and heap all the blame on Europe is just water-carrying hackery.

Saying "NATO will never be the same, and Western European weakness and acquiescence is the cause" is like writing a movie review when you missed the first half of the movie.


Ari Fleischer (@AriFleischer)

When this is over, the western part of NATO will never be the same. Spain, England, France

My goodness, they buried the lede. Apparently there are professional fart smell judges. It's possible the judges were amateurs. But I'm not sure that's better. I can respect someone who smells bagged farts to put food on the table. But someone who just does it out of love?


The Washington Post (@washingtonpost)

Our Ask a Doctor columnist answers the age-old question of whether men or women have worse farts.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/washingtonpost/status/2040165225014387059#m

Really, ignoring messages is news?


Entertainment Weekly (@EW)

Kate Beckinsale has alleged that Mark Ruffalo ignored her message after she claimed an agent fired her for supporting Palestine and a ceasefire in the region. ew.com/kate-beckinsale-says-…




— https://nitter.net/EW/status/2040175040906334310#m

unusual_whales (@unusual_whales)

Trump on pulling out of NATO: "I don't need Congress for that decision"

Video
  


Community note: US law prohibits the president from unilaterally withdrawing the US from NATO; Section 1250A of the 2024 NDAA requires two-thirds Senate approval or an act of Congress. congress.gov/bill/118th-con… crsreports.congress.gov/product/pdf/R/… cnn.com/2026/04/01/pol…



— https://nitter.net/unusual_whales/status/2040187838868726150#m

After 10 years of Trump, some people are still surprised that he doesn't care what the Deputy Assistant to the Secretary of whatever says in a memo. They loved it when they didn't like the memos but now they're crying "No fair!" when Trump continues to ignore them.

Riding the tiger when it's going the direction you want isn't a justification for whining when it turns in a different direction -- or on you.


The Megyn Kelly Show (@MegynKellyShow)
